newsitem.title: FRANCE: French shares lose further ground on rate worries.
newsitem.headline: French shares lose further ground on rate worries.

text.p: French shares extended their losses at midafternoon on Tuesday on worries about a German rate hike to stem the mark's fall against the dollar. Bundesbank chief economist Otmar Issing told a German weekly magazine that keeping the mark stable was a key priority of the central bank.
* CAC-40 index was down 17.08, or 0.57 percent, at 2,975.33 at 1236 GMT.
* CAC-40 Aug futures 2,986 vs 2,997 at Mondays close.
